name: Ethiopian Airlines
desc: Africa's largest airline group, wholly owned by Ethiopia's sovereign fund, flying about 145 international passenger and 70 cargo destinations.

name: HUK-Coburg
desc: Germany's largest motor insurer, a mutual association serving more than 13.5 million customers with car, home, health and life cover.

name: Baillie Gifford
desc: Partner-owned Edinburgh investment manager running growth equity portfolios and investment trusts for institutions and retail investors worldwide.

name: Bonpreu
desc: Font family-owned Catalan grocer running 140 Bonpreu supermarkets, 64 Esclat hypermarkets and 70 EsclatOil fuel stations.

name: Blackmores
desc: Australian natural health and vitamin supplements company sold in 17 Asia-Pacific markets, acquired by Kirin in 2023.

name: QatarEnergy
desc: State-owned Qatari energy company producing LNG, oil and petrochemicals, expanding North Field LNG capacity and investing in ventures on five continents.

name: Fazer
desc: Finnish family-owned confectionery, bakery and oat-products group behind Fazer Blue, Tyrkisk Peber and Froosh, operating in eight countries.

name: Foundever
desc: Customer-experience outsourcing group formed from Sitel and Sykes, running contact centres and digital CX services for brands worldwide with about 170,000 staff.

name: TÜV Rheinland
desc: Cologne-based testing, inspection and certification group founded in 1872 with 25,900 employees, 16,400 of them outside Germany.

name: Fiege
desc: Fifth-generation family-run German contract logistics group operating 130-plus sites for retail, e-commerce, industry and healthcare clients.

name: Neora
desc: Texas-based direct-selling skincare, hair-care and wellness company founded in 2011 by Jeff Olson, selling through brand partners in nine countries.

name: Bira 91
desc: Indian craft beer brand made by B9 Beverages, founded by Ankur Jain and backed by Sequoia, Sofina and Kirin Holdings.

name: Kirkland & Ellis
desc: Chicago-headquartered law firm with about 4,145 lawyers, the world's highest-grossing firm, centred on private equity, M&A and restructuring.

name: Air Europa
desc: Spain's third-largest airline, a SkyTeam member hubbed at Madrid-Barajas flying about 200 daily flights to 70 destinations in Europe and the Americas.

name: SPC Group
desc: Korean food group behind Paris Baguette, Samlip and Korean Baskin Robbins, Dunkin' and Shake Shack franchises, expanding in the US.

name: Mammut
desc: Swiss maker of climbing, mountaineering and outdoor apparel and equipment, owned by Philippe Jacobs' Jacobs Capital since 2021.

name: Louis Dreyfus Company
desc: Merchant and processor of agricultural goods such as grains, oilseeds, coffee, cotton, sugar and juice, with origination, logistics and processing assets worldwide.

name: Nord Anglia Education
desc: Operator of more than 80 premium international day and boarding schools for students aged 2 to 18 across 33 countries.

name: Boodles
desc: Family-owned British fine jeweller designing diamond and gem jewellery sold through its own boutiques in London, northern England and Dublin.

name: Lux Med
desc: Polish private healthcare group owned by Bupa, running over 300 own facilities and 16 hospitals and serving more than three million patients.

name: Related Companies
desc: New York-based private real-estate developer and investor behind Hudson Yards, with about USD 70bn of assets and 4,000+ employees.

name: bolttech
desc: Singapore insurtech running an embedded insurance exchange linking about 700 distribution partners with more than 230 insurers worldwide.

name: Refresco
desc: World's largest independent bottler, producing private-label and contract-packed soft drinks and juices for retailers and brand owners.

name: Miba
desc: Austrian family-led maker of sintered components, engine bearings, friction materials, power electronics components and coatings.

name: InMobi
desc: Mobile advertising technology company running an in-app ad platform and DSP/SSP for advertisers and app publishers, founded in India with 22 offices in 12 countries.

name: Murrelektronik
desc: German developer and maker of decentralised automation and installation technology for machine and plant builders.

name: GardaWorld
desc: Montreal-based private security, cash-logistics and international risk-protection company with about 120,000 employees, owned by Rhone and its founder.

name: Artsana
desc: Italian maker of Chicco baby products and Pic medical devices, 60% owned by Investindustrial, selling in over 150 countries.

name: Zucchetti
desc: Italian family-led software group providing HR, payroll, ERP, accounting, hospitality and retail software plus related hardware to businesses and professionals.

name: igus
desc: German maker of energy chains, plastic plain bearings, chainflex cables and low-cost robotics components from high-performance polymers.

name: KHS
desc: German maker of filling, packaging and PET systems for beverage, food and non-food producers, a Salzgitter group subsidiary.

name: Plansee Group
desc: Austrian family-held group making molybdenum and tungsten products and, via majority-owned Ceratizit, carbide cutting tools.

name: Herrenknecht
desc: Founder-led German maker of tunnel boring machines, deep drilling rigs and mining automation equipment for traffic, utility and energy tunnelling.

name: AQR Capital Management
desc: Greenwich quantitative investment manager founded by Cliff Asness and partners, managing about USD 128 billion with offices on four continents.

name: Magna Steyr
desc: Graz-based contract vehicle engineer and manufacturer that develops and assembles complete cars for other carmakers, part of Magna International.

name: Inspired Education Group
desc: London-based group running about 125 premium private schools for roughly 95,000 students in 30 countries.

name: Tipalti
desc: Finance-automation platform that lets mid-sized and large companies pay suppliers, contractors and employees worldwide and automate accounts payable.

name: Hayfin Capital Management
desc: London alternative asset manager providing direct lending, special opportunities, liquid credit, secondaries and maritime finance across Europe and the US.

name: Pinarello
desc: Italian premium racing-bicycle maker founded in 1953, long-time bike supplier to Team Sky and INEOS Grenadiers, owned by Ivan Glasenberg.

name: Axel Springer
desc: Berlin media group publishing Bild, Welt, Politico, Business Insider and, since 2026, The Telegraph; owned by Friede Springer and Mathias Döpfner.
